prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
How to decide:
1. Find the model number (letters and digits, e.g. PSLX350H or MDR-J10) in the price-list item.
2. A candidate with the same model number is the same product, ignoring case, dashes and spaces,
   and ignoring a colour or variant suffix such as /BLUE or BK/WH on an otherwise identical base
   model. Different wording, descriptions or prices do not matter.
3. If no candidate shares the model number, pick one only when brand and product type are the
   same and the names share distinctive words. Otherwise answer "none".
4. Never answer "none" only because the wording or the price differs.
Confidence: 0.9 or more when the model number matches; 0.6 to 0.8 when brand and product type
match but no model number can be compared; below 0.5 when you are unsure.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else. Write "reason" first: one sentence that
compares the model numbers of the item and the best candidate. Then decide.
{"reason": "<comparison>", "choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>}

Price-list item:
name: Logitech Driving Force Pro Steering Wheel With Pedals Set For Sony Playstation 2 - 9632930403; brand: logitech; description: Logitech Driving Force Pro Steering Wheel With Pedals Set For Sony Playstation 2 - 9632930403/ Comfortable Soft Full Rubber Wheel/ Realistically Turn Through 2.5 Times Wheel Rotation/ 900 Degrees Of wheel Steering/ State-Of-The-Art Force Feedback Technology/ Stick Shifter/ Responsive Gas And Brake P...; price: $129.00

Candidates:
1. name: Logitech Driving Force Pro for PlayStation 2 - 963293-0403; brand: Logitech; check: no model number to compare, brand equal
2. name: Logitech Harmony 890 Advanced Universal Remote - 966193-0403; brand: Logitech; price: $248.90; check: no model number to compare, brand equal
3. name: Logitech Digital Precision PC Gaming Headset - 981-000040; brand: Logitech; description: Logitech Digital Precision PC Headset; price: $31.99; check: no model number to compare, brand equal

response.text: {"reason": "The price-list item and candidate 1 share the same base model number without color or variant suffixes, 9632930403.", "choice": 1, "confidence": 0.9}
